subject: Exec compact: quarter kickoff — OKR consensus & sign-off process
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2027-04-25T09:02:00Z
Subject: Exec compact: quarter kickoff — OKR consensus & sign-off process

Team —

Attaching the initial Q2 OKR draft (Q2_OKR_draft_v1.xlsx). Goal here is to land a concise "exec compact" that summarizes the priorities we will present at the QBR: 3 company-level outcomes, the 6 cross-org OKRs we'll track, and the top 5 risks/mitigations.

Asks this week:
- Please review the attached draft and add or update metric owners in column D by EOD Tue (2027-04-27).
- Call out any conflicts with deliverable timelines (esp. quantization/benchmarking and Dedicated capacity runway).
- If you have material asks for the QBR packet, note them inline in the shared doc (link below).

Operational notes:
- New: I'm proposing an "exec compact" one-pager (2nd tab) that the SLT will sign off on before we lock the broader OKR doc. This keeps the QBR executive slide concise.
- Proposed sign-off cadence: review -> one synchronous 30-min alignment call (Apr 28) -> final sign-off by May 1 close of business PT.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=docs_for_q2_exec_compact

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Go-to-Market Strategy | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachment: Q2_OKR_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-25T11:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec compact: quarter kickoff — OKR consensus & sign-off process

Jonas —

Thanks for kicking this off. Quick read-through notes:
- Under company outcome #2 ("Sustain inference economics"), we should separate token-cost targets from latency SLOs — both matter but require different owners. Suggest: Marcus for cost, Karthik for latency/tech SLOs.
- On the compact one-pager: can we include a short customer impact example (1 bullet) to make the ask tangible for execs? I can draft a 2-line blurb using OptimaHealth as an example if helpful.

I'll add owner names to the sheet today and flag where we need more measurement detail.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, Product | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-26T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec compact: quarter kickoff — OKR consensus & sign-off process

Agree with Lauren. Adding two things:
1) Cost transparency — please include a target for per-token cost reduction (5% baseline-to-quarter) under the economics OKR. I attached a short cost assumptions PDF.
2) Can we schedule a 30-min sync Apr 28 @ 10:00 PT to walk the compact and call out where we need trade-offs? I'm in for that slot but can move.

Attaching: cost_assumptions_q2.pdf (summary)

Marcus Lin
GM, Platform Economics | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-26T10:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec compact: quarter kickoff — OKR consensus & sign-off process

Quick technical callouts:
- Quantization experiments we planned for mid-May will not produce deployable models until late June unless we reduce scope. If we want the runtime improvements to count toward Q2 OKRs, we need to limit the experiment to a single model family and defer multi-model testing to Q3.
- KV-cache prefixing improvements are on track and can contribute to latency wins by the end of May.

Proposal: Mark the quantization work as a phased OKR — phase 1 (single-model proof) for Q2, phase 2 (multi-model roll) for Q3. This keeps the OKR honest and gives product/eng a realistic deliverable.

-- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Inference Runtime | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-26T13:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec compact: quarter kickoff — OKR consensus & sign-off process

Thanks — good alignment emerging.

Decisions captured (will update the attached sheet and the shared doc):
- Owners: Marcus -> cost/per-token targets; Karthik -> latency & runtime SLOs; Lauren -> product success metrics and customer example (OptimaHealth blurb).
- Quantization: phase 1 (single-model proof) included in Q2; full multi-model scope moved to Q3.
- Compact one-pager: add customer impact blurb and top-5 risks (I will draft).

Action items (owners / due):
- Marcus: populate cost target numbers in the sheet (due 2027-04-27 EOD).
- Karthik: add phased quantization wording and expected dates (due 2027-04-28 AM).
- Lauren: customer impact 2-line blurb and finalize metric owners (due 2027-04-27 EOD).
- Jonas: produce the exec-compact one-pager and circulate for final review (will share updated doc Apr 28).

I scheduled a 30-min alignment call: Apr 28, 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

Drive (updated): https://drive.google.com/open?id=docs_for_q2_exec_compact

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Go-to-Market Strategy | Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-01T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Exec compact: quarter kickoff — OKR consensus & sign-off process

Team —

Read the one-pager and the updated OKR sheet. High level: I approve the exec compact as written with two small edits:
1) Reword company outcome #1 to explicitly call out "customer reliability" rather than "service resiliency"; that language resonates more with Sales/CS.
2) Add a single line under risks that flags procurement leadtime (we had a build-vs-buy risk last year that became a gating item).

Everything else looks good — proceed to finalize the QBR packet. Jonas, you have my sign-off once the two edits above are applied.

Grace O'Connor
Chief Operating Officer | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
